title: A place for everyone
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson all the 12 tribes 
get a place to call their own 
in the PROMISED LAND

The promised land was called the land of 
milk and honey
BECAUSE LOTS & LOTS OF GREEN GRASS for COWS and GOATS to eat
and flowers for the busy bees

ACTIVITY TIME
Why don’t you make a yummy MILKSHAKE

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you that we can live with you one day in Heaven
Thank you for all the food that you provide for us
And thank you for giving us a place to live
Amen
